events.title: Full Stack Web Development Workshop
events.description: A comprehensive 3-day hands-on workshop covering React, Node.js, Spring Boot, and REST APIs. Learn to build production-ready web applications from scratch with industry best practices.
events.organizer: CodeTroopers Club of Department of CSE & IEEE Student Branch of SMVITM

events.title: Hackothsava 2023
events.description: Hackotsava is an innovation-driven hackathon that brings together students, developers, and technology enthusiasts to solve real-world challenges through creativity and collaboration. Participants will work in teams to ideate, design, and develop innovative solutions based on industry-provided problem statements within a limited timeframe.

events.title: Cloud Computing & DevOps Talk
events.description: Technical session on cloud-native architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices using AWS and Docker. Led by senior club members with industry internship experience.

events.title: AI Nexus
events.description: The AI & Object Detection Peer Learning Workshop was conducted with the objective of introducing students to cutting-edge technologies in Artificial Intelligence, including Large Language Models (LLMs), chatbot development, and computer vision techniques such as object detection.
events.organizer: CodeTroopers Club of Department of CSE, IEEE Computer Society and IEEE Student Branch of SMVITM

events.title: Workshop on 3D Photogrammetry
events.description: The Objective of the workshop was to use 3D modelling as a process of creating digital three-dimensional representation of a real-world object using multiple images.
events.organizer: Department of CSE/ ISTE Student Chapter of SMVITM

events.title: stackSync
events.description: A hands-on workshop document for building a REST API in Flask, connecting it to MySQL, and consuming it from a frontend using fetch().
